topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 368 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 136 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (protocolgovernance, ownerpausableupgradeable, ownableupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
